issues.description: torch.cuda.set_device called with None local_rank when launcher omits it
issues.detail: args.local_rank defaults to None. If launched via deepspeed/torchrun without --local_rank but with LOCAL_RANK env var, this is None and torch.cuda.set_device(None) will fail before deepspeed.init_distributed(). Default to int(os.environ.get('LOCAL_RANK', 0)) or make required.

issues.description: trainer_args key mismatch: docstring says max_steps but code reads max_step
issues.detail: Docstring lists max_steps/val_interval, but __init__ reads trainer_args['max_step'] and never uses val_interval. Config files following the documented schema will KeyError on init. Either rename the key, update docstring, or use .get with defaults to avoid silent mismatch.

issues.description: Checkpoint saved every train() iteration, ignoring save_interval semantics
issues.detail: run() calls train() which advances by save_interval steps, then unconditionally saves and validates each loop. If train() exits early (iterator exhausted before save_interval steps), checkpoints accumulate at non-aligned steps and max_step may never be reached. No safeguard against infinite loop when global_step does not advance.

issues.description: log_interval declared but never used; metrics logged every step
issues.detail: self.log_interval is read from trainer_args but wandb.log fires on every training step in train(). This wastes wandb storage and contradicts the documented log_interval contract. Either honor log_interval by gating wandb.log, or remove the attribute and documentation.

issues.description: Validation stats divided by world_size twice via all_reduce then mean across batches
issues.detail: _all_reduce_stats divides SUM by world_size so each rank already has the global mean per batch. Then valid() averages per-batch values across batches with simple mean, which is unweighted by batch size and may bias results when batches are uneven. Document or weight by token/sample count.

issues.description: Argument naming inconsistency: hyphen vs underscore
issues.detail: Most flags use --train-config style (hyphens) but --local_rank and --resume_path use underscores. This is inconsistent and the latter may conflict with deepspeed launcher conventions vs user expectations. Standardize on hyphens for user-facing flags and rely on argparse's automatic dest mapping.

review.summary: The PR introduces a DeepSpeed training launcher and trainer wrapper for SpeechLM. Two correctness issues stand out: torch.cuda.set_device(args.local_rank) will crash when launchers pass LOCAL_RANK via env var rather than CLI, and the trainer reads trainer_args['max_step'] while the docstring promises 'max_steps' (also val_interval is documented but never read). Several training-loop concerns exist: checkpoints/validation are unconditional per outer loop iteration, log_interval is unused, and validation averaging may double-normalize across world_size and batches. Minor style nit on flag naming consistency.
